points: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil with 0.5 tsp salt for the noodles.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press). Cut the lime into wedges.
Trim the green beans and cut into thirds.
steps.title: Get Prepped

points: When your pan of water is boiling, add the noodles and green beans.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and run under cold water to stop the noodles sticking together and to keep the veg vibrant.
steps.title: Cook the Noodles and Beans

points: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper.
Fry until golden brown on the outside and cooked through, 8-10 mins.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw chicken and its packaging. The chicken is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Time to Fry

points: While the chicken cooks, in a jug or bowl, mix together the boiled water and sugar for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts), soy sauce, peanut butter and ketjap manis.

notes.text: The peanut butter will loosen more when it warms up in the hot pan.

steps.title: Make the Peanut Sauce

points: Once the chicken is cooked, add the yellow Thai style paste and garlic to the pan. Cook until fragrant, 1 min.
Add the cooked noodles, beans and peanut sauce, stirring until well combined, 2-3 mins. Add a splash to loosen the sauce if needed.
Add a generous squeeze of lime juice. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.
steps.title: Combine and Stir

points: Share your peanut noodles between your bowls.
Serve with any remaining lime wedges alongside for squeezing over.
steps.title: Serve
